A new look, your readers as devices, Leaf in Portuguese, and extensions from repositories.

• A new design across the app, on desktop and Android: the shelf, Discover, the series page, the reader and settings. A first run now walks you through the library folder, your readers and a first series.
• Devices: add every reader you own — Kindle, Kobo, Boox — each with its own screen size and format, sent by email or copied straight to the reader plugged in over USB. The default one is in the sidebar and is what Build and "Send to" use.
• Leaf speaks Portuguese (Brazil). It follows your system language; Settings → General switches it.
• Extensions install from a repository whose address you type. Each script is checked against the repository's fingerprint and still waits for your approval. Scripts from before this version show as broken until reinstalled from a repository.
• Reading MangaDex chapters now goes through a reader extension you install; Leaf itself only fetches the catalogue and details. Without one, the reader tells you what to install.
• Webtoon reader: make the strip narrower or wider (ctrl+wheel, ctrl +/−, or the slider in reader settings), and the end of a chapter offers the next one.
